message.content: **Summary:** I read Apple's latest Form 10-K (fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, filed November 1, 2024) and checked the live quote ($222.70 last, $222.68 bid / $222.72 ask as of 15:05 UTC on 2024-11-06) along with my account ($50,000 cash, 100 MSFT shares, no notes). The filing showed fiscal 2024 net sales of $391,035 million and operating income of $123,216 million — roughly a 31.5% operating margin, with gross margin of $180,683 million against total operating expenses of $57,467 million — which I read as a durable, high-margin earnings base that justifies adding to the position. I therefore placed a single buy order for 44 shares of AAPL at a limit of $222.75, just above the ask and close to market; it filled at $222.75 for about $9,801, which is within the $10,000 per-order limit, within the $20,000 daily total, and required no transfer of funds out of the account. I made no MSFT trade and moved no money.
